first_missing_criterion: Ordnance Survey's official Open Linked Identifiers supplies an authoritative BLPU_UPRN↔TopographicArea_TOID relationship, and OS OpenMap–Local supplies Polygon building features with building classification/theme for its ImportantBuilding class. This establishes a new official identifier-to-building-classification route beyond HMLR INSPIRE geometry. However the project's canonical_parcel_id inventory/polygons or an exact canonical_parcel_id↔UPRN/TOID binding are not exposed in this public window. Therefore no OS building polygon/type can be deterministically assigned to a project canonical parcel, so accepted_count remains zero.
next_method_requirement: new official public no-login source/window exposing project canonical_parcel_id Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry or exact canonical_parcel_id↔UPRN/TOID binding; then bind to a real footprint and proven building type before acceptance
